name: Scenario AQ: Trades Job Intake
comments: Triggered by a Freshchat conversation.created webhook. Keyword filter detects trades-related terms (quote, estimate, repair, install, fix, job). Claude extracts job type, address, and urgency from the message. Creates a HubSpot deal with job details. Sends admin a job summary email. Generates an AI Freshchat response confirming receipt and estimated response time. Error route sends an internal alert via Resend. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Fires on conversation.created. Case-insensitive regex filter passes conversations containing trades job keywords. Register Make webhook URL in Freshchat Admin > Settings > Webhooks > Conversation Created.
Claude extracts job_type, address, urgency level, and estimated_response_time from the raw Freshchat message. Temperature 0.1 for deterministic extraction.

HUBSPOT_STAGE_NEW_LEAD.label: HubSpot Deal Stage — New Lead
HUBSPOT_STAGE_NEW_LEAD.notes: Pipeline stage ID for new trades job deals.

notes.label: Module 1 — Freshchat Webhook + Trades Filter
notes.note: Fires on conversation.created. Case-insensitive regex: quote|estimate|repair|install|fix|job. Only matching conversations proceed.

notes.label: Modules 2–3 — Claude: Extract Job Details
notes.note: Claude extracts job_type, address, urgency (emergency/urgent/standard/flexible), and estimated_response_time. ParseJSON (module 3) makes them accessible as structured fields.

notes.label: Module 4 — HubSpot Deal Creation
notes.note: Creates a deal with the extracted job details. Priority is HIGH for emergency/urgent. Deal name format: <job_type> — <customer name> (<date>).

notes.label: Module 5 — Resend: Admin Job Summary
notes.note: Colour-coded HTML email to brian@cwiai.net. Red header for emergency, orange for urgent, blue for standard. Includes full job details, customer info, HubSpot deal ID, and Freshchat conversation ID.

notes.label: Modules 6–7 — Freshchat AI Confirmation
notes.note: Claude generates a personalised 2-3 sentence confirmation (module 6) that is immediately posted to the Freshchat conversation (module 7). onerror on module 2 also sends a hardcoded fallback message if Claude fails entirely.
